title: Conventional trabeculectomy versus trabeculectomy with the Ex-PRESS mini-glaucoma shunt: differences in postoperative interventions

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 unported, incorporated in Dove Medical Press terms (article <license>, ali:license_ref); non-commercial, therefore any record would be private

indication: POAG, pseudoexfoliation, secondary (uveitic, one steroid) and angle-closure glaucoma, first trabeculectomy with MMC (conventional or with Ex-PRESS P50 under a scleral flap), with or without simultaneous phacoemulsification (triple surgery), follow-up > 1 year; retrospective single-surgeon study (Toyama, Japan)
record: none: no admissible series under protocol 1.0.0 (no build run)

exclusions.what: Table 2 IOP series of the conventional and Ex-Press groups (t2-opth-12-643 C2, C3; Pre-IOP and 1-5 years, eyes in parentheses)
exclusions.reason: analysis set selected by a postoperative outcome: table footnote a and Results state that the results of eyes that underwent additional glaucoma surgeries were excluded (protocol rule 4, eyes 'without additional glaucoma surgery')

exclusions.what: Table 3 IOP series of the Single and Triple surgery groups (t3-opth-12-643 C2, C3)
exclusions.reason: the table shares the outcome-defined exclusion as far as can be checked: all patients were followed > 1 year, yet the Table 3 eye totals at 1 and 2 years equal the Table 2 totals that exclude eyes with additional glaucoma surgery (the 3- and 4-year totals differ by one eye, so the analysis set is also not fully documented); treated as an outcome-selected analysis set (protocol rule 4; triage note flagged this)

exclusions.what: Table 4 IOP before and 1/3/6 months after needling
exclusions.reason: subset selected by a postoperative intervention (eyes that needed needling), protocol rule 4
reference only, no follow-up in this table
reported in text only, without tabulated values

exclusions.what: Kaplan-Meier success (Figure 1), failure counts, Table 5 complications, medication columns
exclusions.reason: success proportions, Kaplan-Meier estimates, counts and medication numbers are not admissible IOP series

notes: Tonometer: Goldmann applanation tonometry (method would be 'goldmann'); preoperative IOP = mean of IOPs at three visits while on preoperative treatment (would be 'preoperative_medicated').
Groups would have been conventional trabeculectomy and trabeculectomy with Ex-PRESS (both 'trabeculectomy' context, both standard techniques, 'control'), and single versus triple surgery (Table 3).
Only the earlier-operated eye of bilateral patients was analyzed; three planned Ex-PRESS cases were converted to conventional trabeculectomy.
